summary_notes: Current Ananta real GPU gates complete model and TTS but host-timed clip swaps still violate strict audio scheduling; do not loosen gates or mark full migration complete.
Existing avatar surface handover is preserved; sample-clock preparation is additive execution infrastructure and has no membership/policy/Hub task authority.

Prepared content has no guessed speech generation: decode preparation precedes native speech opening; the clock binds only the actual returned generation. A completed generation cannot activate an old prepared sequence. Shared wire constants preserve old exports without making content/quality depend on speech lifecycle.

Decoder uses paused muted owned blob metadata/seek and ImageBitmap copying, never play or capture. In-flight bitmap work retains the preparation permit until it settles; late results are closed. Artwork checks authority before/after pixels and after observers; old generation/failure retires the atlas.

Preparation binds exact current native source/session/lease/membership/expiry and independent absolute/monotonic bounds; old assets cannot cross changed authority. Native activation validates actual speech progress before taking atlas ownership. New40fps source pacing is additive; existing profiles remain5fps with unchanged deadlines/heartbeat. Leave/destroy cancels unpublished preparation.

Worker native sequence is explicitly opt-in (MEET_COMPANION_NATIVE_SEQUENCE=1); no automatic fallback after selected native failure. Preparation precedes speech, current Hub checks stay active and exact live native quality receipts are validated. One-frame tail balancing preserves the existing maximum120 frames per clip.

Clock/renderer tasks are implemented and individually verified with actual native GPU delivery and source gates. Worker/block task stays open because full repository Node gate found separate native broadcast audio revoke failure and current-image crash/hardware withdrawal confirmation is pending. No archived completion or productive release claim.
